0x0007D8.en: 「This is all I've got...@ so this is as far as I go...!」

0x000849.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008D1.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009FA.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A32.en: 「Well, well...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B36.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This ain't funny...」

0x000B8A.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CDB.en: 「This is as far as I go... the rest is up to you.」

0x000D87.en: 「No good, too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DD4.en: 「Well, that's that. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E12.en: 「Kyah, the rest is in your hands!」

0x000F04.en: 「Ngh... So I become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000FFC.en: 「Oh boy, I've gone and gotten myself done in!」

0x001040.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x0010AD.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010F4.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001129.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x001215.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still not ready...!」

0x001263.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Falling back!」

0x00131E.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x00134D.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x00138B.en: 「Well now, so this is the end.」

0x0013BA.en: 「I can go no further. Please excuse me.」

0x001445.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x0015AB.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! So much for a graceful exit...」

0x0017A9.en: 「This is as far as I go!!」

0x0017D8.en: 「So I've still got a ways to go...!」

0x0019A2.en: 「Why didn't you tell me@　that Filio was sick......!?」

0x001A29.en: 「Even if it was an illness that couldn't be cured,@　I at least wanted to know......@　Then maybe......」

0x001ACD.en: 「Ibis......@　if you'd known Filio's life was almost over,@　could you have completed GRaMXs?」

0x001B72.en: 「If we'd known Filio was going to die,@　could we have achieved our true goal?」

0x001BFC.en: 「All we can do is what we're able to do......@　With the wings Filio left us.」

0x001C98.en: 「Series 77... Code Alpha.@　One of the culminations of <Project TD>.」

0x001D2C.en: 「That's not what we should be thinking about now.@ First, we have to complete the Altairlion.」

0x001DA3.en: 「<Isurugi Heavy Industries> has promised@　to keep backing us financially.」

0x001E41.en: 「Even if it's to put <Project TD>'s results@　to military use, right now all we can do@　is cling to that support.」

0x001ED9.en: 「So that we can keep <Project TD> going,@　even after losing Filio.」

0x001F50.en: 「The Altairlion tests begin tomorrow......@ Rest well tonight, Ibis.」

0x001FCD.en: 「Filio... I'll never see you again, will I......」

0x002007.en: 「From the day Filio collapsed until now......@　I wish it had all just been a dream......」

0x00207E.en: 「Filio taught me to look up at the sky,@　to gaze at the stars......」

0x0020E6.en: 「But I can't see them......@　The sea of stars, not anymore......」

0x002139.en: 「Current position, Point SN1339.@　100 kilometers north of the <Aidoneus Island> blockade zone.」

0x0021AC.en: 「Altairlion Cruise Figure,@ low-speed basic cruise test, checklist items through 04 cleared.」

0x00222F.en: 「Fiona, I know you just joined us, but......@　I'm counting on you for backup.」

0x0022AD.en: 「Yes.@　Thank you for entrusting this job@　to our L&E Corporation.」

0x002328.en: 「Also, this doubles as a field test of our@　Excellence Rescue unit......@　so 30% off the usual fee is fine.」

0x0023D3.en: 「You just started the company - money must be tight, right?@　I'll pass on the discount.」

0x002444.en: 「We appreciate the thought.@　Leave any rescue or repairs to us.」

0x0024EF.en: 「And you, Raul, don't act like a president at all.@　Even with such a capable secretary.」

0x00257A.en: 「Raul, here......@　This is the latest Altairion data@　Tsugumi sent over.」

0x0025F8.en: 「Ah, thanks.@　......I see, so that's how it is.」

0x002689.en: 「It's because everyone's been so kind to me......」

0x0026C9.en: 「She's a big help with the work too.@　After all, our president and VP have no interest in running things.」

0x00275B.en: 「If you've got complaints, you be president.」

0x0027A1.en: 「If I ended up in that seat,@　both you and Raji would dump@　all the annoying jobs on me.」

0x002825.en: 「That's exactly why I made you president, big brother -@　as a preventive measure.」

0x002893.en: 「Geez, nothing good ever comes@　of you calling me big brother.」

0x0028F2.en: 「Yes, yes, Mr. President. Let's get to work.」

0x002926.en: 「Being called president feels weird too.@ ......Now then, the Altairlion data...」

0x002997.en: 「From what I heard when we took the job,@　it still needs a lot of tuning.」

0x002A22.en: 「<Project TD>'s final product,@　the newest Series 77. A fully variable@　<Armored Module>......」

0x002AB9.en: 「If they go all out, the Excellence@　would be left in the dust in no time.」

0x002B36.en: 「Well, no doubt about that.@　Their <Tesla Drive> is on a whole other level from ours.」

0x002BB3.en: 「......Besides, the Altairlion is@ Filio's final work......」

0x002C12.en: 「Yeah......@　To think he was suffering from a serious illness......」

0x002C68.en: 「Seems Ibis was never told about it.@　Filio asked Tsugumi to keep it that way.」

0x002D06.en: 「All right, Ibis......@　Next we move to checklist item 05.」

0x002D59.en: 「......Tsugumi, why did you call Raul and the others?」

0x002D9C.en: 「In case something unexpected happened@　during this long-distance cruise test,@　I asked them for backup.」

0x002E2F.en: 「......Guess there's no helping it, with skills like mine......」

0x002E6C.en: 「That's right.@　Judging by how things have gone so far, my decision@　looks to have been the correct one.」

0x002EEB.en: 「With the Astelion AX's data fed back into it,@ the Altairlion should outperform the AX@ in every respect.」

0x002F96.en: 「Even accounting for the first flight and your inexperience,@　acceleration, stability, turning radius... every test@　came back low.」

0x00302F.en: 「That's because it's a low-speed cruise.@　If I push the speed higher......」

0x00309A.en: 「I can't entrust high-speed testing to a pilot@　who can't fly stably at low speed.」

0x00310E.en: 「Ibis......@　I know you're shaken by what happened@　with Filio.」

0x003189.en: 「But right now, look only ahead.@　That's what Filio would have wanted too.」

0x00321A.en: 「Sleigh would handle the Altairion@　far better than me, I'm sure......」

0x0032DF.en: 「Flying objects, closing fast. Five of them.」

0x003356.en: 「I've got a bad feeling about this......!」

0x003381.en: 「The flying objects will be in visual range shortly.」

0x003428.en: 「They're Lion-series lines, but@　there's <Personal Trooper> tech in them too...?」

0x003514.en: 「Raul and the others are here.@　We can't just turn tail and run now.」

0x0035A1.en: 「Save the whining for later!@ Ibis, protect the Altairlion!」

0x003644.en: 「Raul, we'll draw them off!@　Use the chance to get away!」

0x0036E9.en: 「But that Excellence is for rescue work......!」

0x00372F.en: 「Actually, under the pretext of clearing debris,@　we've got weapons loaded too.」

0x003788.en: 「Times being what they are,@　Dr. Hamill and Dr. Radom recommended it......」

0x0037EA.en: 「And I agreed to the measure myself.」

0x003868.en: 「Everyone, our rescue unit's debut@　had to turn out like this, but......」

0x0038D3.en: 「Well, that's just like us.@　Despinis, I'm counting on you for support.」

0x00392C.en: 「ET-OS, battle mode!@　FCS, set! Here we go!!」

0x003988.en: 「Of the enemy machines, only the two in front@　seem to be actively coming after us.」

0x0039F6.en: 「So they're just testing the waters first...!?」

0x003A2D.en: (Their aim isn't to wipe us out......@ In that case, are they after the Altairlion's data...?)

0x003AB6.en: 「Tsugumi, CF doesn't have enough firepower.@　Let me transform to DF and......」

0x003B18.en: 「If the enemy is after the Altairlion,@ we can't let them see all its functions.」

0x003B9F.en: 「Calm down, Ibis.@　They're mobility-focused machines,@　so CF's firepower should be plenty to fight them.」

0x003C38.en: 「Watch the enemy's movements closely and land your hits for sure.」

0x003DE4.en: （No way... it's not supposed to be...!）

0x003E3A.en: 「Just who the hell are these guys?」

0x003E71.en: 「Don't ask me, how should I know?」

0x003EEB.en: 「Only one place besides us could have built it.」

0x003F98.en: （Could it be... the one piloting the Vegalion was@　Sleigh...?）

0x003FF4.en: 「Raul, there's debris on the water.@　Looks like some kind of capsule.」

0x004069.en: 「It resembles a mobile weapon's escape pod.」

0x0040A9.en: 「Then there could be someone inside.@　Let's bring it in.」

0x0040FF.en: 「It might tie in to those guys.@　Be careful, Raul.」

0x00416E.en: 「Ibis...!@　Factor in your speed relative to the target!@　You can't just charge in!」

0x0041FF.en: 「Tesla engine or not,@ this is still an Excellence!@ Don't underestimate it!!」

0x0042A2.en: 「Raul, looks like what we recovered@　is a mobile weapon's escape pod.」

0x004326.en: 「Yeah... a boy, maybe fourteen or fifteen.」

0x004360.en: 「What...?@　Not a military pilot or anything?」

0x0043AD.en: 「He wasn't carrying anything to identify himself.」

0x004406.en: 「It's Earth-made, no doubt about that...@　but we'll have to look into the details.」

0x00448A.en: 「Judging by the pod's damage...@　it's been adrift for quite a while. So it may@　have nothing to do with those guys.」

0x004538.en: 「So he was in a different mobile weapon...@　got shot down, and ejected?」

0x004611.en: 「No good. He's badly hurt and unconscious.@　Despinis and Mizuho are treating him now, but...」

0x00469A.en: 「With this Rescue's medical gear,@　he won't hold on for long.@　We need to get him to a hospital, fast...」

0x004724.en: 「Easier said than done.@　There's no island with a hospital anywhere near here...」

0x004789.en: 「...The thing you recovered, what was it?」

0x0047C3.en: 「It seems to be a mobile weapon's escape pod...@　with an unidentified boy inside.」

0x004831.en: 「He's gravely injured and unconscious...@　We need to move him somewhere with@　proper medical facilities.」

0x0048C7.en: 「A grim situation.@　We can't get information from someone who's out cold...」

0x00495D.en: 「If it's real treatment you need, I have an idea.」

0x0049C2.en: 「Yes.@　The Steel Dragon Squadron is running drills in these waters.」

0x004A2E.en: 「A unit formed after the <Shura Rebellion>.@　Their carriers are the Hagane and Hiryu Kai. The members@　are people we're well acquainted with.」

0x004ACC.en: 「So if we take the boy there...」

0x004B0C.en: 「That's the idea, but...@　the Hagane and Hiryu Kai are running drills@　against each other, so they're apart right now.」

0x004BB1.en: 「I'll send you each ship's position and access@　code, so head to whichever one you like.」

0x004C4A.en: 「Still, Tsugumi...@　how do you know about the Steel Dragons' drills?」

0x004CAF.en: 「Actually, as part of the Altairlion's tests,@ we were set to take part in the drills too.」

0x004D29.en: 「Then you're joining the Steel Dragons as well?」

0x004D60.en: 「We were supposed to meet the Hagane,@ but we're heading back to the <Tesla Leicht Institute>@ to confirm something.」

0x004E2F.en: 「If we stay with you,@　we might only bring more trouble down on you.」

0x004EA0.en: 「And if they show up again,@ I'll shake them off with the Altairlion's speed.@ So don't worry.」

0x004F55.en: 「All right, we'll be on our way, then.」

0x004FB7.en: 「You too.@　On top of all this, the disappearances at Tesla@　aren't someone else's problem either...」

0x005098.en: 「Raul, let's make contact with the Steel Dragon Squadron.」
